fields.hero_h1: Custom Mirrors and Glass in Toronto and the GTA
fields.hero_subhead: Wall mirrors, vanity mirrors, glass shelving, and table tops, measured, cut, and installed clean across the GTA.
fields.overview_heading: Custom mirrors and glass, cut to fit
fields.overview_body:
SolidGuard supplies and installs custom mirrors and cut-to-size glass across Toronto and the GTA. Frameless wall mirrors, beveled vanity mirrors, gym and closet mirrors, measured to your space and installed level and secure. Mirror installation is clean, fast, and done right the first time.

Beyond mirrors, we cut glass shelving and protective glass table tops to any shape and size. Whether it is a single wall mirror installation or a set of custom mirrors for a fit-out, we measure on site and finish every edge for a safe, polished look.

faqs.question: Do you make mirrors to a custom size?
faqs.answer: Yes. We measure on site and cut custom mirrors to any size and shape, with finished edges, frameless or beveled.

faqs.question: Can you install a large wall mirror?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wall mirror installation is a common job for us, mounted level and secure on any wall type.

faqs.question: Do you cut glass shelving and table tops?
faqs.answer: Yes, cut-to-size glass shelving and protective glass table tops, with polished edges for safety.

faqs.question: Do you serve the whole GTA?
faqs.answer: Yes, across Toronto and the GTA.
